reviews.review:
Had this on my watch list for a while, but finally grabbed it during the 1-year mark for Early Access.  The first day of the free-to-play weekend convinced me this was a fun buy.

Deep Rock Galactic fills the same niche as Left 4 Dead in my library, but the mechanics they are developing during access makes this one more rewarding to play long term.  Also the various characters are very much class-based roles you will want to match to both your play style and the needs of your group when you start a mission.

The Early Access is honest about where it still needs some polish, and for some players it may take a bit to get used to the poly design of characters and environment.  I recommend giving it time as you should see eventually how this allows for the fully destructible environments to feel fluid and worthwhile as well as act as a style to lean into and play with from a development standpoint.

While the solo play has solid support the game is best when you have friends to play with, which is why I see this as a great successor to the co-op style that Left 4 Dead popularized.  Best bought with at least one friend getting in on it as well.

Who should be playing:  Anyone that thinks digging for treasure in Minecraft would be improved with swarm rush combat.  Anyone who thinks the idea of Space Dwarves is awesome.
Who Should Avoid:  Shooter fans who like their ammo to be easy to replenish, arachnophobes, speedrunners

Such a great game, one of my favourite ones by far. The game's about dwarfs that need to mine stuff on an alien planet
exploring caves that are randomly generated. There are 4 classes and each of them do something different:
Driller-  He makes way for his fellow team mates.
Scout- He scouts the way ahead and mines the diamonds that others can't get.
Engineer- He can place sentries and can make platforms for his team mates.
Gunner- Defends his team mates with his minigun and can place zip line.

Each of the classes has got their own weapons and you can get perks for your dwarf and attachments for weapons. 
The game has also got somewhat decent customization, getting more customization objects by playing more, you can also play it solo, where you will be accompanied by a robot called  "Bosco"   that will help you.
Just buy the game.
If you have good friends to play with, this game has an immense amount of replay value. Single player can be played, but it's so much better with friends playing as all four classes.

Think Left4Dead or Vermintide but Starship Troopers; You’ll have a fair idea what this game is all about. Be it single player or 4 person co-op, this game is pretty fun. As is, my only real complaint is that it gets repetitive real quick but it is still a good game worthy of at least checking it out on a sale.
